limitations: The 282 assigned-pair records contain repeated physical pair IDs across gating/similarity cases (38 unique frame/plane pairs).

Candidate graph omits zero-edge planes; unmatched_plane rows cannot recover these.

Source and target centroids in bmr_plane_features_original_frames.csv are in their own frame coordinates; do NOT compare them directly without relative-pose transformation.
